title: Velocity 2011:  Jon Jenkins, "Velocity Culture"
summary: Amazon's Jon Jenkins at Velocity 2011 on how operations can drive revenue and on Amazon's highly available, autonomous architectures. It includes details on deployment frequency and Amazon's move to AWS.
why: HN commenters cite it as a primary source for facts such as Amazon.com running on AWS and its very frequent deployments.

quote.text: the mean time between deployments on an average weekday is 11.6 seconds.
